title: Create your POST account
summary: Sign up with your mobile number or email in a few short steps.
text:
## Sign up
1. Open POST and choose to create a new account.
2. Enter your first and last name.
3. Choose your birthday with the date wheel and tap Set date. You must be at least 13 years old to use POST.
4. Choose your gender.
5. Enter your mobile number or your email address, then continue. If you want to use an email, tap Sign up with email.
6. Enter the confirmation code that POST sends to you.
7. Choose your @username.
8. Create a password with at least 6 characters. By continuing you agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
9. Add a profile picture, then you will see the welcome screen.
## If something goes wrong
- No code arrived: wait for the resend timer to finish, then tap Resend code. Check your spam folder if you used an email.
- The username is taken: choose another one. Usernames can be at most 20 characters.
- You already have an account: tap I already have an account on any sign-up screen to go to the login screen.

title: Log in and log out
summary: Log in with your email or mobile number and fix login problems.
text:
## Log in
1. Open POST and tap Log in.
2. Enter your Email or Mobile number and your Password.
3. Tap Log in. If Two-factor authentication is on, enter the code that POST sends to your email or phone.
## Log out
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy.
2. Scroll down and tap Log out, then confirm Log out of your account?.
3. To log out of other phones or browsers, open Settings and privacy > Security and account access > Where you're logged in.
## If you cannot log in
Check that you typed the same email or mobile number you used when you signed up. If you forgot your password, tap Forgot password? on the login screen and follow the steps in Managing your account > Login and password.
If your account is scheduled for deactivation, log in before the restore date and use Restore My Account (see Managing your account > Deactivate and reactivate accounts).

title: Find your way around POST
summary: What each tab and menu item does.
text:
## The main tabs
- Home: your feed of posts and reels. The blue + button creates a new post.
- Search: find people and posts, see your Recent searches and People you may know.
- Reels: full-screen short videos. Tap the camera button to create a reel.
- Friends: your chats, group chats and friend list.
- Notifications: likes, comments, follows, mentions and tags.
- Profile: your own posts, videos and followers.
## The side menu
- Profile: open your own profile.
- Get Verification: apply for the verified badge.
- Our Planet: read news and world stories and save the ones you like.
- Saved: posts and stories you saved.
- Saved Drafts: posts you started but have not published.
- Settings and privacy: account, security, privacy, notifications and display options.
- Help Center: the guides you are reading now.
- Invite Friends: share POST with people you know.

title: Create a post
summary: Write text and add photos or videos, choose who can see it, then publish.
text:
## Publish a post
1. On the Home tab, tap the blue + button.
2. Write your text and add photos or videos.
3. Choose the audience: Public, Friends, Only show to… (specific people) or Only me.
4. Tap to publish. Your post appears on your profile and in the feeds of the people who can see it.
## Not ready to publish?
You can save your work as a draft. Open the side menu and tap Saved Drafts to continue later.

title: Photos and videos in a post
summary: How many photos and videos you can add and how they are shown.
text:
## Limits
- You can add up to 10 photos to one post.
- Videos can be up to 20 minutes long. All videos in one post together can be up to 20 minutes.
- If you add more than the limit, POST shows a message and does not add the extra files.
## How people see them
Posts with several photos show as a stack. People swipe to move through the photos and tap a photo to open it larger.

title: Create a Reel
summary: Record or choose a video and share it in the Reels tab.
text:
## Make a reel
1. Open the Reels tab and tap the camera button (Create reel).
2. Record with the camera or choose a video. In the camera you can use Audio, Effects, Touch Up and Length, and the flash, speed and timer buttons at the top.
3. Go to the editing page. You can add text, stickers, effects and music.
4. Continue to the New reel page, write your details and share the reel.
## Length
A reel can be up to 20 minutes long. The camera starts with a 15 second length, which you can change with the Length button.

title: Reel templates
summary: Choose whether other people can reuse the audio and timing of your reel.
text:
## What a template is
Templates allow anyone on this app to use the same audio and timing as your reel, and replace the photos and videos with their own.
## Don't let others use your reel as a template
1. Open the Reels tab, tap the camera button and create your reel.
2. On the share page, tap More options.
3. Under What others can remix and reuse, turn on Don't let others use this reel as a template.
4. Go back and share your reel.

title: Hide like and share counts on a reel
summary: Keep the number of likes and shares on your reel private.
text:
## Hide the counts
1. Open the Reels tab, tap the camera button and create your reel.
2. On the share page, tap More options.
3. Under How others can interact with your reel, turn on Hide like count on this reel, Hide share count on this reel, or both.
4. Go back and share your reel.
## Good to know
Only you will see the number of likes and shares on this reel. You can change this later by going to the three dots menu at the top of the reel. You can hide the number of likes and shares on reels from other accounts by going to your account settings.

title: Allow downloads of your reels
summary: Choose whether people can download your reels.
text:
## Turn downloads on or off
1. Open the Reels tab, tap the camera button and create your reel.
2. On the share page, tap More options.
3. Under How others can interact with your reel, use the switch next to Allow people to download your reels.
4. Go back and share your reel.
## Good to know
When this is on, anyone can download your public reels, original audio from your reels and remixes by others. You can turn off downloading for individual reels from the more menu.

title: Delete a post or reel
summary: Remove something you published.
text:
## Delete
1. Open your post or reel and tap the options menu (three dots) on it.
2. Tap Delete post (or Delete reel).
3. Confirm. The post is removed from your profile and from other people's feeds.
## Good to know
The options menu on your own post offers Delete. To change something in a published post, delete it and publish it again.

title: Like, comment, repost and share
summary: React to posts and send them to other people.
text:
## On every post
- Like: tap the heart. Tap again to remove your like.
- Comment: tap the comment icon and write your comment.
- Repost: share the post on your own profile. Reposts appear in the Reposted tab of your profile.
- Share: send the post to others or copy its link. You will see Link copied when the link is copied.
## Counts
Counts update everywhere in POST: Home, profile, Saved and Notifications show the same numbers.

title: Save posts and drafts
summary: Keep posts to read later and finish unpublished posts.
text:
## Saved
1. Tap the save (bookmark) icon on a post, reel or Our Planet story.
2. Open the side menu and tap Saved to see everything you saved. Tap an item to open it in a feed that starts at the item you tapped.
3. To remove an item, tap the save icon again. You will see Removed from Saved.
## Saved Drafts
Posts you started but did not publish are in Saved Drafts in the side menu. You can open a draft, rename it and publish it later.

title: Follow people and see your followers
summary: Follow accounts and manage your Followers, Following and Mutuals lists.
text:
## Follow
1. Open the profile of the person and tap Follow.
2. If their account is private, your request is sent and they must approve it first.
3. Tap Following to stop following.
## Your lists
On your profile, tap the Followers or Following count to open the list. The tabs are Followers, Following and Mutuals (people who follow you and whom you follow). Tap Follow back to follow someone who follows you. Suggested for you appears below the list.

title: Search for people and posts
summary: Find accounts, see your search history and clear it.
text:
## Search
1. Open the Search tab and type a name, @username or a topic.
2. Tap a result to open the profile or post.
3. Under People you may know, tap See all for more suggested accounts.
## History
Recent shows what you searched and visited. Tap See all to open History, with the tabs All, Searches and Visits.
To clear it, tap the menu icon on a history row and choose Delete search history and visits?, then pick 24 hours, 7 days, 4 weeks or All time.

title: Messages and group chats
summary: Chat one-to-one or in groups from the Friends tab.
text:
## Send a message
1. Open the Friends tab.
2. Tap a chat in the list, or search for a friend to start a new one.
3. Type your message and send it.
## Group chats
Create a group from the Friends tab and add friends. Group admins can invite people with an invite link or QR code and choose what members are allowed to do.
## Who can message you
Go to Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety > Who can message / follow you. For messages choose Everyone, Friends only or No one.

title: Invite friends to POST
summary: Share POST with people you know.
text:
## Invite
1. Open the side menu and tap Invite Friends.
2. Choose how to share the invite link: WhatsApp, SMS, Copy Link (you will see Invite link copied) or More for other apps.
3. When your friend joins, you can find and follow each other from the Search tab.

title: Notifications
summary: See your activity and choose which alerts you get.
text:
## See your notifications
Open the Notifications tab. Tap a notification to open the post, reel or profile it is about. A reel opens in the Reels viewer and a post opens like a Home feed post.
## Choose your alerts
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy > Notifications.
2. Turn on or off Likes, Comments, Follow requests, Messages, Mentions and Tags.
3. Changes are saved when you switch a toggle.
## Not getting alerts on your phone?
Also check your phone or browser settings and allow notifications for POST.

title: Our Planet
summary: Read news and world stories inside POST.
text:
## Open Our Planet
1. Open the side menu and tap Our Planet.
2. Browse the stories and use the search to find a topic.
3. Tap the save icon on a story to find it later in Saved.

title: Get the verified badge
summary: How to apply for verification and what to prepare.
text:
## Apply
1. Open the side menu and tap Get Verification. Read the benefits screen and continue.
2. Enter your Full name and, if you want, your Username.
3. Choose the account type: Individual, Business or Government.
4. Explain why your account should be verified, and add supporting links if you have them.
5. Upload a proof of identity. The file must be smaller than 10 MB.
6. Submit the request. POST reviews it within 2 to 3 days.
## Good to know
- You can have only one pending request at a time.
- If your account is already verified you cannot apply again.
- If your name is very similar to an account that is already verified, your request is flagged for extra review.
- The badge shows next to your name across POST.

title: About account security
summary: Use strong sign-in details and the security controls in POST to keep your account protected.
text:
## Keep your account secure
Use a strong, unique password for your POST account. Do not reuse that password on other websites.
Turn on Two-factor authentication and Login alerts in Settings and privacy > Security and account access. A new sign-in then needs a code, and you get an alert when your account is opened on a new device.
Only sign in through the official POST app or your trusted POST website. Never enter your password into a link sent by an unknown person.
## If you think your account was hacked
Change your POST password immediately in Settings and privacy > Security and account access > Change password. If you can still sign in, open Where you're logged in and log out any device you do not recognize.
Check your email address, phone number, profile details, and recent posts for changes you did not make. Contact POST Support if you cannot restore the account yourself.

title: Password strength
summary: Create a password that is difficult to guess and different from the passwords you use elsewhere.
text:
## Do
- Create a long password. POST needs at least 6 characters, but 10 or more is much safer.
- Use a mix of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
- Use a different password for every website you visit.
- Keep your password in a safe place. A reputable password manager can help.
## Do not
- Use personal information such as your phone number, birthday, or name.
- Use common dictionary words such as “password” or “iloveyou”.
- Use sequences such as “abcd1234” or keyboard patterns such as “qwerty”.
- Share your password or reuse your POST password on another service.

title: Protect your account from phishing
summary: Scammers may use fake login pages, messages, or offers to steal your account details.
text:
## Before you sign in
Check that you are using the official POST app or website. Be cautious of urgent messages asking you to verify your account, claim followers, receive money, or avoid suspension.
POST Support will not need your password. Never send your password, one-time code, or recovery code to another person.
## If you entered your details on a suspicious page
Change your POST password immediately, then open Where you're logged in and log out the devices you do not recognize.
If the suspicious message or account is still visible, report it from POST and block the sender.

title: Review sessions and login alerts
summary: See where your POST account is signed in and remove access from an unfamiliar device.
text:
## Review your account activity
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy > Security and account access.
2. Tap Where you're logged in to see your active sessions.
3. Compare the listed devices with the devices you use.
4. Log out any session you do not recognize.
5. Keep Login alerts switched on so POST notifies you about new sign-ins.
## Remember
A session you do not recognize can mean that someone has your password, that you used a shared device, or that the device information changed. Change your password if anything looks suspicious.

title: Control who can see your posts
summary: Your privacy settings let you decide how widely your POST profile and posts can be seen.
text:
## Private account
When your account is private, only people you approve can follow you and see the posts that are limited to followers.
Open Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety and use the Account privacy switch. It shows Private or Public so you can check it was saved.
## Post visibility
Before publishing, check the audience you chose (Public, Friends, Only show to… or Only me). To change who can see your posts in general, open Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety > Post visibility. If one post is visible to the wrong audience, delete it from its options menu.

title: Control messages and follow requests
summary: POST lets you choose who can send messages and who can follow or connect with you.
text:
## Change your privacy controls
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety.
2. Tap Who can message / follow you.
3. For messages choose Everyone, Friends only or No one. For follow requests choose Everyone or Approved only.
4. Save the change.
5. Use Block user or Mute user for a specific account that is bothering you.
## If an account can still interact
Check that the setting was saved. For a specific account, open one of its posts and choose Block user from the options menu, or manage blocked accounts in Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety > Blocked accounts. Contact POST Support if the account can still interact after being blocked.

title: Download your POST data
summary: You can request a copy of the account and content data available in POST.
text:
## Request a copy
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety.
2. Tap Data and activity.
3. Tap Download your data.
4. Save the JSON file (post-app-data.json) when the download begins and keep it in a secure place. Use View activity log to see your recent posts, comments and likes inside POST.
## Protect your downloaded file
The downloaded file may contain account and content information. Do not upload it to a public website or share it with someone you do not trust.

title: Recognize spam on POST
summary: Spam often uses repeated messages, suspicious links, fake rewards, or promises of followers and money.
text:
## Common warning signs
- A message asks for your password, one-time code, or payment.
- An account promises followers, verification, money, or a prize in exchange for your login details.
- A post repeats the same link or request across many accounts.
- A profile copies another person’s name, photo, or identity.
## What to do
Do not open suspicious links or reply with private information. Report the post or account, then block or mute it so it cannot continue to disturb your feed.

title: Report spam or a fake account
summary: Reports help POST review accounts and content that may break the rules.
text:
## Report from POST
1. Open the post or Reel you want to report and tap its options menu.
2. Choose Report.
3. Select the reason that best describes the problem, for example Spam, Impersonation or Hate, Abuse and Harassment.
4. Submit the report. To report a user or content later, open Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety > Report and safety > Submit a report. My Reports shows what you submitted.
5. Choose Block user or Mute user if you do not want further contact.
## Report accurately
Only include information that is relevant to the report. If the account is impersonating you or another person, explain who the real account belongs to and include the profile link when possible.

title: Block or mute an account
summary: Use account controls to stop unwanted contact without continuing to engage with the account.
text:
## Choose the right control
- Block user prevents an account from interacting with you and is the strongest option for unwanted contact.
- Mute user removes an account’s content from your experience without notifying the account.
- Privacy controls such as Who can message / follow you and Comment controls reduce interaction without a full block.
## If the account returns
Report new spam or abuse instead of replying. Keep screenshots or links if the behavior continues and include them when contacting POST Support.

title: Sensitive content controls
summary: Use POST privacy controls to manage whether sensitive content is shown in your experience.
text:
## Manage the filter
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety.
2. Switch Sensitive content on to filter graphic or sensitive photos and videos out of what you see.
3. If content still appears unexpectedly, report it from the post's options menu.
## For young or vulnerable users
If content is upsetting, do not continue viewing or sharing it. Use the report option and block the account that posted it.

title: Report harmful or graphic content
summary: Report content that violates POST rules, including graphic violence, sexual exploitation, or dangerous material.
text:
## Make a report
1. Open the post or Reel and tap its options menu.
2. Choose Report.
3. Select the closest reason, for example Graphic or Violent Media, Child Safety or Suicide or Self-Harm.
4. Submit the report. Do not repost the material while asking for help.
## Urgent danger
If someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services first. You can also report the content to POST so it can be reviewed.

title: Report harassment or abuse
summary: Report behavior that targets, threatens, or repeatedly harms you or another person.
text:
## What to report
- Threats of violence or messages that make you fear for your safety.
- Repeated harassment, hateful abuse, or targeted insults.
- Impersonation, doxxing, or sharing private information without permission.
- Coordinated spam or attempts to manipulate another person’s account.
## Send a useful report
Include the profile, post, or message link, what happened, and when it happened. Keep the report factual and do not send passwords or one-time codes.

title: Block an abusive account
summary: Blocking stops an account from interacting with you while POST reviews a report.
text:
## Block from the account
1. Open one of the account’s posts and tap its options menu.
2. Choose Block user.
3. Choose Report from the same menu if the account broke POST rules.
4. You can see and undo blocks in Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety > Blocked accounts.
## Stay safe
Do not meet someone who is threatening you and do not share your address, phone number, passwords, or private images. Save evidence only if it is safe to do so.

title: Appeal a moderation action
summary: If POST removed your content or limited your account by mistake, contact support with the relevant details.
text:
## What to include
- Your POST username and the link to the affected profile or content.
- The action you are appealing and the date you noticed it.
- A short explanation of why you believe the action was incorrect.
- Any context that helps the review team understand the situation.
## Keep your account safe
POST Support will not ask for your password. Do not pay anyone who claims they can restore your account or remove a moderation action.

title: The POST Rules
summary: POST is a place for public conversation where people can share ideas and connect freely.
text:
## Our purpose
POST exists to serve public conversation. People should be able to express themselves, discover different points of view, and participate without being threatened or targeted.
These rules explain the behavior and content that is not allowed on POST. They apply to posts, replies, profiles, messages, communities, and other features.
## How we enforce the rules
We may limit the reach of content, remove content, restrict features, suspend an account, or permanently remove an account when we find a serious or repeated violation.
We consider the context, severity, and history of an incident. If you believe an action was made in error, use the appeal option shown in the app or contact POST Support.

title: Information for Parents and Minor Users
summary: Safety guidance for younger people and the adults who support them on POST.
text:
## Stay in control
- Use a strong password and never share it, even with someone claiming to be POST Support.
- Keep personal details such as your address, school, phone number, and live location private.
- Block and report anyone who makes you uncomfortable, threatens you, or asks for private images.
- Tell a trusted adult if you see threatening, exploitative, or dangerous content.
## When something feels urgent
If someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or a trusted adult first. POST reports help us review content, but they do not replace emergency help.

title: Username squatting policy
summary: Usernames should represent people, organizations, or communities honestly and not be held only to prevent others from using them.
text:
## What is not allowed
- Registering a username only to sell, transfer, or demand payment for it.
- Using a username to impersonate a person, brand, or organization.
- Creating multiple accounts to reserve many names without a genuine use.
- Using names or marks in a way that is likely to confuse people.
## Report a username
If a username is impersonating you or your organization, report the account from its profile and include the relevant details. We may request information that helps confirm the identity or rights involved.

title: Platform manipulation and spam
summary: Do not use POST to artificially amplify, suppress, or disrupt information or people’s experience.
text:
## Examples of prohibited behavior
- Coordinating fake engagement, including likes, follows, replies, or reposts.
- Using automation to create accounts, publish repeated content, or manipulate trends.
- Posting the same or substantially similar material across many accounts.
- Using misleading links, fake rewards, or mass unsolicited messages to drive activity.
## What happens next
We may remove spam, limit distribution, restrict features, or suspend accounts that manipulate the platform. Do not reply to suspicious messages; report and block them instead.

title: Civic integrity
summary: POST must not be used to manipulate or interfere with elections or other civic processes.
text:
## Civic information
Do not post or share content that intentionally misleads people about when, where, or how to participate in a civic process, including voting, registration, or public services.
Do not coordinate campaigns designed to suppress participation, intimidate voters, or impersonate election officials.
## Report a concern
Report misleading civic content from the post options menu. Include the specific claim and the information that makes it misleading so the team can review it accurately.

title: Misleading and deceptive identities
summary: Do not impersonate individuals, groups, or organizations in a way that deceives or confuses others.
text:
## Identity rules
- Do not copy another person’s name, profile photo, or biography to mislead people.
- Do not claim to represent an organization without authorization.
- Parody and commentary should be clearly described so people are not confused about who is speaking.
- Do not use a fake identity to evade enforcement or harm another person.
## If someone is impersonating you
Open the profile, select Report, choose impersonation, and provide the real account or organization details when requested.

title: Synthetic and manipulated media
summary: Do not deceptively share synthetic or edited media that is likely to cause harm.
text:
## What is not allowed
Do not use edited audio, images, or video to falsely depict a real person saying or doing something when the result could cause serious harm, confusion, or harassment.
Context matters. Clearly labeled parody, commentary, and creative work may be allowed when it is not presented as authentic and is not used to deceive or harm people.
## How to report it
Report the post and explain what has been changed, who appears in the media, and why the presentation is misleading. Avoid reposting harmful material while reporting it.

title: Violent content
summary: Graphic media may be restricted, and threats, incitement, glorification, or expressions of desire for violence are not allowed.
text:
## Violence
You may not threaten, encourage, glorify, or celebrate violence against a person or group. Content that expresses a desire for real-world violence may be removed.
Graphic media may only be shared where it is properly labeled, not prominently displayed, and not excessively graphic. We may remove media that depicts extreme cruelty or exploitation.
## Report an urgent threat
If a post describes a credible and immediate threat, report it from the post options and contact local emergency services when someone may be in immediate danger.

title: Violent and hateful entities
summary: You cannot affiliate with or promote the activities of violent or hateful entities.
text:
## Prohibited support
- Do not praise or promote violent extremist or terrorist organizations.
- Do not recruit for, fund, or provide operational support to violent groups.
- Do not share propaganda or instructions intended to help a violent organization.
- Do not target people with content that encourages violence because of who they are.

title: Child safety
summary: POST has zero tolerance for child sexual exploitation and content that normalizes abuse of children.
text:
## Protecting children
We remove content that depicts, promotes, requests, or facilitates child sexual exploitation. Attempts to groom, sexualize, or contact children for exploitation are also prohibited.
Do not download, save, or share suspected abusive material. Report it directly through POST and provide the account or post link.
## Immediate danger
If a child may be in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or the relevant child protection authority. Do not confront a suspected offender yourself.

title: Abuse and harassment
summary: Do not share abusive content, engage in targeted harassment, or incite other people to harass someone.
text:
## Not allowed
- Repeated unwanted contact, threats, or targeted insults.
- Encouraging others to dogpile, threaten, or expose someone.
- Doxxing or sharing private information without permission.
- Harassment directed at a person because of a protected characteristic.
## Report and protect yourself
Block the account, save the post link if it is safe to do so, and submit a report with clear details. Do not share your password or one-time codes with anyone offering help.

title: Hateful conduct
summary: You may not attack people on the basis of race, ethnicity, national origin, caste, sexual orientation, gender, religion, age, disability, or serious disease.
text:
## Hateful conduct
POST does not allow slurs, dehumanizing comparisons, threats, or calls for exclusion or violence against people because of a protected characteristic.
Discussion of difficult topics, news reporting, and criticism may be allowed when it does not target people with hateful abuse or encourage harm.

title: Suicide and self-harm
summary: Do not promote or encourage suicide or self-harm.
text:
## Supportive conversation
Do not provide instructions, celebrate attempts, encourage self-harm, or share graphic material that could trigger someone. Posts that seek help should receive supportive, non-judgmental responses.
If you believe someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or a trusted person who can reach them.

title: Illegal or regulated goods and services
summary: Do not use POST to sell, buy, or facilitate transactions involving illegal or regulated goods or services.
text:
## Examples
- Illegal drugs, weapons, stolen goods, or instructions for making them.
- Fraud, identity theft, hacking services, or access to compromised accounts.
- Offers that require payment for guaranteed followers, verification, or account recovery.
- Transactions that violate applicable local laws or safety requirements.

title: Copyright and trademark
summary: Do not use someone else’s copyrighted work or trademark in a way that violates their rights or confuses people.
text:
## Copyright
Only post content you created, content you have permission to use, or content covered by an applicable legal exception. Repeated copyright infringement may lead to account restrictions.
Rights holders can report allegedly infringing content with enough information for POST to identify the material and the rights involved.
## Trademarks
Do not use a trademark to impersonate a business or make people believe you are officially connected to it. Commentary, reviews, and fan activity should be clear and not misleading.

title: Third-party advertising in video content
summary: Do not display third-party advertising in video content through POST without prior consent.
text:
## Video advertising
You may not submit, post, or display video content on or through POST that includes third-party advertising, such as pre-roll video ads or sponsorship graphics, without our prior consent.
If you are working with a brand or sponsor, contact POST Support before publishing the campaign so the required review can be completed.

title: Using POST features
summary: Use posts, replies, messages, communities, and other features for their intended purpose.
text:
## Good platform use
- Keep posts and replies relevant to the conversation.
- Respect people’s boundaries and do not send repeated unwanted messages.
- Use reporting and blocking tools instead of retaliating against another account.
- Keep your account details accurate enough for support and recovery.

title: Automation and third-party access
summary: Only use tools and integrations that are authorized and do not put accounts or the platform at risk.
text:
## Account access
Never share your password, one-time code, session token, or private account data with an untrusted service. Review connected access and revoke anything you do not recognize.
Unauthorized scraping, automated account creation, and tools that manipulate engagement may be restricted or removed.

title: Keep your account information accurate
summary: Your email, phone number, username, and profile details help you use and recover your account.
text:
## Review your settings
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy > Your account > Account information.
2. Review your email address, phone number, country and date of birth.
3. Check your username, profile name, and profile photo on your profile.
4. Save changes only from the official POST app or website.
## Protect your details
POST Support will not ask for your password or one-time code. If someone asks for these details, report the account and change your password.

title: Account actions and appeals
summary: Understand what to do when content is removed or your account is restricted.
text:
## If your account is restricted
Read the notice shown in POST and follow the appeal instructions if you believe the action is incorrect. Include the username, affected content, and a short explanation.
Do not create replacement accounts to evade a restriction. That can make the enforcement action more serious.

title: Requests for account information
summary: Law enforcement requests should come through the appropriate legal process and official channels.
text:
## How requests are reviewed
POST reviews valid requests for account information under applicable law. Requests should identify the relevant account, the information sought, the legal authority, and the requested time period.
We may notify users about requests when legally permitted, except where notice is prohibited or an emergency makes notice inappropriate.

title: Emergency requests
summary: Emergency disclosures may be considered when there is a genuine risk of death or serious physical harm.
text:
## Emergency information
Emergency requests should explain the danger, identify the person at risk, identify the account or content, and explain why the information is needed immediately.
A request does not guarantee disclosure. POST evaluates each request and may preserve information when a valid preservation request is received.

title: How POST improves the experience
summary: POST may evaluate features and product changes to understand what helps people connect and participate.
text:
## Responsible testing
Experiments are designed to improve reliability, safety, accessibility, and the usefulness of the service. We use safeguards intended to limit unnecessary impact on people.
Some tests may change how content or features appear for a limited period. We review results before making a wider product change.

title: Research data and privacy
summary: Research should use appropriate safeguards for account and activity information.
text:
## Data protection
Access to research data is limited to authorized work and should follow applicable privacy and security requirements. Personal information should not be used for unrelated purposes.
If you have a question about a product experiment, contact POST Support with the screen or feature you saw.

title: Local law and POST
summary: POST works to provide a service that respects applicable laws while supporting public conversation.
text:
## Regional requirements
Some features, notices, or content restrictions may differ depending on local law and the country where a user is located.
If local law requires a restriction, POST may limit access in that region. We aim to communicate meaningful restrictions and provide an appeal path where available.

title: Request help in your country
summary: Use POST Support to ask about a local notice, report, or account issue.
text:
## What to include
- Your POST username and country or region.
- The feature, post, or notice you are asking about.
- The date and time you saw the issue.
- A screenshot or link when it is safe and appropriate to share.

title: Login and password
summary: How to log in · How to reset a forgotten password · How to change your password while logged in · How to turn on two-factor authentication
text:
## How to log in
1. Open POST and tap Log in.
2. Enter your Email or Mobile number.
3. Enter your password and tap Log in.
4. If Two-factor authentication is on, enter the code that POST sends to your email or phone.
Note: If the password is rejected, use Forgot password? on the login screen.
## How to reset a forgotten password
1. On the login screen tap Forgot password?.
2. Enter the email or mobile number of your account and tap Send code.
3. Enter the 6-digit code and tap Verify.
4. Type a new password with at least 6 characters and confirm it.
5. Tap Reset password, then log in with the new password.
Note: If no code arrives, wait for the timer and tap Resend code. You can also start from Settings and privacy > Security and account access > Account recovery.
## How to change your password while logged in
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy > Security and account access.
2. Tap Change password.
3. Enter your current password, the new password and the new password again.
4. Tap Update Password.
## How to turn on two-factor authentication
1. Open Settings and privacy > Security and account access.
2. Switch on Two-factor authentication.
3. From now on POST asks for a code sent to your email or phone every time you log in.
Note: Login alerts, in the same screen, send you an email, push and in-app alert when your account is opened on a new device.

title: Username, email, and phone
summary: Where to see your account information · How to add or change your email · How to add or change your mobile number · How to add your country
text:
## Where to see your account information
1. Open the side menu > Settings and privacy > Your account.
2. Tap Account information.
3. You can see your username, phone number, email, country and date of birth.
Note: Your @username is shown here but cannot be changed from Settings right now. If you need help with it, use Contact us.
## How to add or change your email
1. Open Settings and privacy > Your account > Change Email.
2. Enter the new email address and continue.
3. POST sends a code to that address. Enter the code to confirm that the email is yours.
Note: An email address can be linked to only one account.
## How to add or change your mobile number
1. Open Settings and privacy > Your account > Change Mobile Number.
2. Choose the country code and enter your number.
3. Enter the code that POST sends to confirm the number.
## How to add your country
1. Open Settings and privacy > Your account > Account information.
2. Tap Country and choose your country from the list.

title: Account settings
summary: How to make your account private or public · How to choose who can see your posts · How to switch dark mode on or off · How to change the language · How to see or unblock blocked accounts
text:
## How to make your account private or public
1. Open Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety.
2. Use the Account privacy switch.
3. Private: only approved followers can see your posts. Public: anyone on POST can see your posts.
## How to choose who can see your posts
1. Open Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety > Post visibility.
2. Choose Everyone, Followers only or Custom (specific people), then save.
## How to switch dark mode on or off
1. Open Settings and privacy > Accessibility, display and languages.
2. Switch Dark mode on or off. The change is instant and is saved to your account.
## How to change the language
1. Open Settings and privacy > Accessibility, display and languages.
2. Tap Language and choose your language.
## How to see or unblock blocked accounts
1. Open Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety > Blocked accounts.
2. Tap Unblock next to the person.
Note: Blocked people cannot find your profile or contact you.

title: Notifications
summary: How to choose which notifications you get
text:
## How to choose which notifications you get
1. Open Settings and privacy > Notifications.
2. Switch on or off: Likes, Comments, Follow requests, Messages, Mentions and Tags.
3. Your choice is saved right away.
Note: Also allow notifications for POST in your phone or browser settings, otherwise alerts cannot reach you.

title: Verified accounts
summary: What the verified badge means · How to request verification
text:
## What the verified badge means
1. The badge shows that POST reviewed the account and the identity proof.
2. It appears next to the name across POST, for example on posts, profiles and search.
3. Tapping About this account in a verified account's post menu shows more information.
## How to request verification
1. Open the side menu and tap Get Verification.
2. Fill in your full name, account type (Individual, Business or Government), the reason and any supporting links.
3. Upload a proof of identity (smaller than 10 MB) and submit.
4. POST reviews the request within 2 to 3 days.
Note: Only one request can be pending at a time.

title: Suspended accounts
summary: Why an account can be restricted · How to ask for a review
text:
## Why an account can be restricted
1. POST can limit or suspend an account that breaks the Rules and policies.
2. Common reasons are spam, impersonation, harassment or sharing harmful content.
3. Do not create a new account to avoid a restriction. That can make the action more serious.
## How to ask for a review
1. Open Help Center > Contact us.
2. Choose Appeal a decision as the topic.
3. Write your @username, what was restricted or removed, and why you think it was a mistake.
4. Add the email where you want the reply and send the request. You get a ticket number.
Note: POST Support never asks for your password or a login code. Do not pay anyone who says they can restore an account.

title: Deactivate and reactivate accounts
summary: How to deactivate your account · How to restore your account
text:
## How to deactivate your account
1. Open Settings and privacy > Your account.
2. Tap Deactivate your account and read the page.
3. Tap Deactivate. Your display name, @username and public profile are no longer visible to others.
Note: You can restore the account within 30 days. After 30 days the account and all data are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
## How to restore your account
1. Log in before the restore date.
2. Open Settings and privacy > Your account.
3. Tap Restore My Account. Your profile becomes visible again.
